title: parse('next friday') returns today on a Friday
text: Called on Friday 8 May, parse('next friday') gives 8 May. `next` should never mean today, so I expected 15 May.

title: Duration.from_iso rejects weeks combined with days
text: Duration.from_iso('P1W2D') raises ValueError: unexpected designator 'D'. ISO 8601-2 allows weeks with other units.

title: Every-other-week schedule moves an hour after the clock change
text: Schedule('every 2 weeks on monday at 09:00', tz='Europe/Lisbon') yields 10:00 for every date after 29 March.

title: format_relative says 'in 0 days' for later today
text: format_relative(now + 3 hours) returns 'in 0 days'. It should say 'in 3 hours'.

title: Document the strict flag of parse
text: The README mentions parse(..., strict=True) once but never says what it rejects.

title: parse accepts 30 February
text: parse('2026-02-30') returns 2 March instead of raising, with strict=True as well.

title: Schedule.between is slow for minute rules over a year
text: Schedule('every minute').between(jan_1, dec_31) takes 40 s because it steps one occurrence at a time.

title: Accept 'fortnight' as a duration unit
text: parse_duration('1 fortnight') raises. The unit is common in UK timetables and could mean 14 days.

title: Next weekday never means today
text: On a Friday, `next friday` is a week away.

patch:
--- a/brindle/parse.py
+++ b/brindle/parse.py
@@ -88,3 +88,3 @@ def next_weekday(start, weekday):
     """The first `weekday` after `start`, never `start` itself."""
-    days = (weekday - start.weekday()) % 7
+    days = (weekday - start.weekday() - 1) % 7 + 1
     return start + timedelta(days=days)

text: P2W on its own fails now.

title: Local-time occurrences for biweekly rules
text: The rule runs in local time.

patch:
--- a/brindle/schedules.py
+++ b/brindle/schedules.py
@@ -112,3 +112,4 @@ class Schedule:
     def _occurrence(self, n):
-        at = self.anchor + n * self.period
-        return at.astimezone(self.tz)
+        local = self.anchor.astimezone(self.tz).replace(tzinfo=None)
+        at = local + n * self.period
+        return at.replace(tzinfo=self.tz)

--- a/brindle/durations.py
+++ b/brindle/durations.py
@@ -58,2 +58,4 @@ def from_iso(text):
     parts = {k: int(v) for k, v in m.groupdict().items() if v}
+    if set(parts) == {"weeks"}:
+        return Duration(weeks=parts["weeks"])
     days = parts.pop("weeks", 0) * 7 + parts.pop("days", 0)

text: Validate the day against the month
patch:
--- a/brindle/parse.py
+++ b/brindle/parse.py
@@ -140,2 +140,4 @@ def _date(year, month, day, strict):
     """The date, or InvalidDate for one the calendar does not have."""
-    return date(year, month, 1) + timedelta(days=day - 1)
+    if not 1 <= day <= calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]:
+        raise InvalidDate(f"{year}-{month:02d} has no day {day}")
+    return date(year, month, day)

text: Count hours within the same day
patch:
--- a/brindle/formatting.py
+++ b/brindle/formatting.py
@@ -22,2 +22,5 @@ def format_relative(then, now=None):
     delta = then - (now or datetime.now(then.tzinfo))
+    if abs(delta) < timedelta(days=1):
+        hours = round(abs(delta).total_seconds() / 3600)
+        return f"in {hours} hours" if delta > timedelta(0) else f"{hours} hours ago"
     days = delta.days

title: Skip whole periods in between()
text: between() starts at the first period in range.
Jump to the first period in range
patch:
--- a/brindle/schedules.py
+++ b/brindle/schedules.py
@@ -140,5 +140,3 @@ class Schedule:
     def between(self, start, end):
-        n = 0
-        while self._occurrence(n) < start:
-            n += 1
+        n = max(0, math.ceil((start - self.anchor) / self.period))
         while (at := self._occurrence(n)) < end:

text: The start bound is excluded now: 09:00 to 18:00 loses 09:00.

title: COUNT rules spend the count on excluded dates
text: Schedule('every day', count=5, exclude=[may_3]) returns four dates; the excluded date still uses up the count.

patch:
--- a/brindle/schedules.py
+++ b/brindle/schedules.py
@@ -140,3 +140,3 @@ class Schedule:
     def between(self, start, end):
-        n = max(0, math.ceil((start - self.anchor) / self.period))
+        n = max(0, math.floor((start - self.anchor) / self.period))
         while (at := self._occurrence(n)) < end:

text: Minute rules across the clock change return 01:30 twice.

patch:
--- a/brindle/durations.py
+++ b/brindle/durations.py
@@ -12,3 +12,4 @@ UNITS = {
     "day": timedelta(days=1),
     "week": timedelta(weeks=1),
+    "fortnight": timedelta(weeks=2),
 }

title: Count only included dates
text: Excluded dates no longer use up COUNT.

patch:
--- a/brindle/schedules.py
+++ b/brindle/schedules.py
@@ -160,2 +160,3 @@ class Schedule:
     def _counted(self, dates):
-        return itertools.islice(dates, self.count)
+        kept = (d for d in dates if d.date() not in self.exclude)
+        return itertools.islice(kept, self.count)
